title: 1954 Elmer Wiley Principal and teacher at HHS
description: Elmer H. Wiley returned to Hartland in 1948, originally from St. Andrews, to assume the principal position, having served from 1935 to 1937 and then taking several years off. During the war, he worked on the administrative and training staff of the 2nd Battalion, Carleton & York Regiment, and later taught at McAdam. His wife, formerly Inez Smith of Hartland, and their two daughters joined him. Mr. Wiley is set to teach Grade 11.
